convert_metaseq_weights_to_ft: convert Metaseq model weights from FSDP-consolidated shards into FasterTransformer format using a glob pattern
convert_weights_reorder_tensors: reorder and transpose decoder layer weights from Metaseq state dict into FasterTransformer layout
int8_quantize_weights: quantize selected weight tensors to int8 using FasterTransformer symmetric quantization for memory efficiency
reorder_kvq_to_qkv: reorder a KVQ-packed tensor into QKV layout by permuting head dimensions
run_conversion_cli: run the conversion script via fire CLI with input glob, output pattern, dtype, and quantize flags
